name: Debug Anything
description: Reviews Debug Anything tools that attach observation probes to running processes, containers, or pods (strace, py-spy, perf, gdb/lldb, heap snapshots) or capture network traffic. Debug Anything is read-only by design and never elevates: when a probe needs root it fails closed and prints the sudo command for the operator to run themselves, then analyzes the saved output via import_artifact. Listing and reporting tools inherit host policy. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use readiness, list_processes, inspect_sockets, inspect_files, container_info and report, which only read system state and never attach to a process.
When a probe would need elevation, run the printed sudo command yourself and feed the saved output to import_artifact instead of granting Debug Anything anything.
capture_traffic additionally requires consent: true in the call itself and is capped at 30 seconds.
